end.summary:
Counted corners of 2D shapes in 5 attempts, all unaided correct.
Counted sides in 2 attempts, all unaided correct.
Named shapes from their sides and corners, including rotated triangles, in 7 attempts, all unaided correct.
Discussed circles, diamonds, squares, rectangles, triangles, and a shape with a cut corner.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners, then naming shapes even when their position changed. Ayaan explained that a circle has no corners, identified both rotated triangles, and counted five corners on a shape with one cut corner. They also noticed when a side had been counted twice. At home, ask them to find shapes around the house and say both the number of sides and corners.
